canonical_project: Kommunaler IT-Service (KitS) centralized county IT/data-center infrastructure
notes: KitS centralized the district's IT on Dell VxRail HCI and operates services for the Landratsamt, 54 schools, and public entities; separate 2021 school data-center cooperation with Wartburgkreis/Eisenach covers 123 school sites. Sources also show the district uses the Thüringer Rechenzentrum for KitS, so the physical hosting location may be external to the district.
